title: The agent loop
intro: An agent is that same model call, repeated. After your program runs a tool, it appends the result to messages and calls the model again. The loop stops when the model returns text instead of a tool call.

steps.author: system
steps.label: System
steps.text: You are a coding agent. Tools: read_file, edit_file, run_command. Read files before answering about their contents.
steps.narration: The system message lists three tools the model may request: read_file, edit_file, and run_command.

steps.author: user
steps.label: User
steps.text: The test for add fails. Fix it.
steps.narration: The user says a test is failing. The files are not in the message list, so the model cannot see their contents yet.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call
steps.narration: The model returns a tool call for read_file on test_app.py. Your program will run that function.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.narration: Your program reads the file and appends the contents to messages. Then it calls the model again with the updated list.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call
steps.narration: The model now has the test. It asks to read app.py.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.text:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
steps.narration: add(2, 2) returns 4. The test asserts 5. That mismatch is now in the message list.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call
steps.narration: The model asks edit_file to change the expected value from 5 to 4.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.narration: The edit ran. Append that observation and call the model again.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call
steps.narration: The model asks to run pytest.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.narration: pytest passed. Append that result and call the model again.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Assistant
steps.text: The implementation returns the correct sum. I changed the test to expect 4 from add(2, 2), and the test passes.
steps.narration: This reply has no tool_calls. The loop returns the text and stops.
